author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
Hello.

It's time to end something that was started last fall.

In an alternate dimension, our map making contest might have ended well.

Koja and I were going to each pay half of the cash prize, and we also would've bought the setnext tokens (because nobody actually calls the damn things "gadgets") with our own money.

If you were really trying to get the prizes, I apologize to you deeply. But it would just be silly to hand things out when the server's closing in less than two days.

To those who made maps, I am very grateful that you put the effort in. While some of the maps had issues, I believe all of you are capable of excellent work.

I'm going to give you the gameplay and aesthetic scores, along with the match times. You can do the math if you wish, but I don't really see a point in giving you a score out of 120.

All the gameplay and aesthetic scores are averaged per map, and rounded to the next highest increment of 0.5.

Here are the scores, in order of best gameplay to worst gameplay. In case of a tie, better aesthetics are listed above worse aesthetics.

A New Day II:
Gameplay = 8
Aesthetics = 8
Match Time = 8m 43s

Gyrus:
Gameplay = 7.5
Aesthetics = 8
Match Time = N/A (Lasted 22 minutes before the server crashed.)

Race:
Gameplay = 7
Aesthetics = 8
Match Time = 9m 1s

Jigsaw:
Gameplay = 7
Aesthetics = 7
Match Time = 11m 31s

Red Citadel:
Gameplay = 5.5
Aesthetics = 7
Match Time = 7m 7s

Plaza:
Gameplay = 5
Aesthetics = 8
Match Time = 4m 1s

Karnak I:
Gameplay = 4
Aesthetics = 8
Match Time = N/A (Lasted 28 minutes before the server crashed.)

Guerrilla:
Gameplay = N/A (Not tested; authors did not submit a map download.)
Aesthetics = N/A (Not tested; authors did not submit a map download.)
Match Time = N/A (Not tested; authors did not submit a map download.)
